permission_semantics: PG18.4 general datid/pid/usesysid are assigned before privilege branch. backend_start/backend_type are gated, NOT globally public. has_privs_of_role is self, superuser or INHERIT-option reachability, not SET/ADMIN. usename belongs view join. No role escalation or grant is authorized.
selector: For the existing expected governed client-backend roster: use public complete active PID/role/DB rows, join each expected PID to an independent complete bridge enrollment/birth receipt. A row for protectedrole without exact bridge birth =>UNKNOWN/NOTQUALIFIED; no worker inferred safe. Session disappears/renames/restarts or revision changes invalidates comparison.
bridge_equivalence: backend_status.c copies MyStartTimestamp; frozen LOGIN module captures exact same variable. Its accepted event-trigger path requires getpid()==MyProcPid and MyBackendType==B_BACKEND. Independent observer validates retained sender PIDFD/birth + approved bridge binary/source + generation/context/enrollment. This is not a claim an untrusted caller says its own type/start.
raw_vs_selected: Never fill protected PG column NULL with a bridge value under pg_stat_activity provenance. Raw catalog projection stays exact, may contain permission-redacted NULLs. Separate selected fact receipt names bridge provenance and identical retained process/session identity. Handoff fact-composition contract is an input to deferred qualification derivation, not a change to closed codec or producer graph.
snapshot_binding: Use closed13-event mutation/generation/session protocol plus independent receiver/census observer progression. pgstat row seqlock copies are coherent per row, NOT all rows MVCC-consistent; require complete public roster/no missing expected row and observer before/after birth set, same registry generation/context. Any incomplete bridge stage, mismatch, duplicate, stale receipt or nonclient row =>UNKNOWN.
future_proof: Measure approved bridge/backend/source binary identity, complete authenticated binding and observer receipts at later build/runtime gate; no runtime value fabricated. Two independent original completed-work observer requirements remain unchanged.
